title: Quantum Computations on Fusion Blanket Molten Salts
summary: Molten salts such as FLiBe (2LiF--BeF$_2$) are leading blanket materials for breeding and recovering tritium in fusion reactors. Predicting tritium speciation requires accurate electronic ground-state energies for representative molten-salt clusters, a demanding task for correlated electronic-structure methods. Here we report the first application of heterogeneous quantum--classical computing to tritium binding in FLiBe.
